title: 第一卷 第12章 这招够狠的
slug: 大明死谏一百次老朱破防了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

程壑川不敢动。

“朕让他跪的。”朱元璋说。

“陛下，”马皇后端起参汤递过去，“先喝汤。喝完汤，再罚跪也不迟。”

朱元璋端起参汤喝了一口，脸上的怒气稍稍缓和了一些。

马皇后趁机开口了。

“陛下，臣妾听说，程御史修《元史》修得还不错？”

“是不错，”朱元璋放下碗，“但修史之余，还有闲心管闲事。”

“管什么闲事？”

“跑到东宫去，让太子帮他查一个钦犯的案子。”

马皇后看了程壑川一眼，又转向朱元璋。

“陛下，臣妾不懂朝政，但臣妾想问一句，程御史让太子查的那个人，到底有没有罪？”

朱元璋没有说话。

马皇后继续说：“如果那个人真的有罪，程御史就是多管闲事，该罚。但如果那个人是被冤枉的，程御史就是在替陛下做事，替陛下查清楚真相，免得陛下杀错人。”

“臣妾记得，陛下当年在应天府的时候，最恨的就是那些不问青红皂白就抓人杀人的官吏。陛下说过，‘我朱重八打天下，为的就是让老百姓能过安生日子。要是连审案都审不清楚，那跟元朝那些狗官有什么区别？’”

“这话，陛下还记得吗？”

朱元璋沉默了。

马皇后说的这句话，是他早年最得意的一句话。

那时候他还没当皇帝，还在跟陈友谅、张士诚打仗。

他说这话的时候，是真心实意的。

“陛下，”马皇后的声音放得更低了，“臣妾不是替程御史说话，臣妾是替陛下着想。陛下杀胡惟庸，满朝文武没有一个人敢说半个不字。臣妾当时就觉得奇怪，胡惟庸当了七年丞相，难道真的一个朋友都没有？真的一个替他说话的人都没有？”

“后来臣妾想明白了。不是没有，是不敢。”

“满朝大臣，不管跟胡惟庸有没有关系，都在急着跟他撇清关系。有的人为了表忠心，甚至主动去告发别人。周德清告发陈宁，不就是这么回事吗？”

朱元璋的手在桌上轻轻敲了两下。

“程壑川，”他终于开口，声音不再那么冷，“那个陈宁的案子，太子查得怎么样了？”

Cheng Hechuan didn't dare to move.

"I asked him to kneel down." Zhu Yuanzhang said.

"Your Majesty," Queen Ma picked up the ginseng soup and handed it over, "Drink the soup first. After drinking the soup, it's not too late to kneel down as punishment."

Zhu Yuanzhang took a sip of the ginseng soup, and the anger on his face softened slightly.

Queen Ma took the opportunity to speak.

"Your Majesty, I heard that Cheng Yushi did quite well in the "History of the Yuan Dynasty"?"

"That's true," Zhu Yuanzhang put down the bowl, "but apart from studying history, I still have time to meddle in other people's affairs."

"What are you minding?"

"Run to the East Palace and ask the prince to help him investigate a case of imperial criminals."

Queen Ma glanced at Cheng Hechuan and then turned to Zhu Yuanzhang.

"Your Majesty, I don't understand government affairs, but I would like to ask if the person Cheng Yushi asked the prince to investigate is guilty?"

Zhu Yuanzhang said nothing.

Queen Ma continued: "If that person is really guilty, Cheng Yushi is meddling in his own business and deserves to be punished. But if that person is wronged, Cheng Yushi is working for His Majesty to find out the truth for Your Majesty, so that His Majesty will not kill the wrong person."

"I remember that when His Majesty was in Yingtian Mansion, what he hated most were those officials who arrested and killed people without asking any questions. His Majesty once said, 'I, Zhu Chongba, conquer the world just to let the people live a peaceful life. If I can't even judge the case clearly, what's the difference between me and those dog officials of the Yuan Dynasty?'"

"Your Majesty, do you still remember this?"

Zhu Yuanzhang was silent.

What Queen Ma said was his most proud sentence in his early years.

At that time, he had not yet become emperor, and was still fighting with Chen Youliang and Zhang Shicheng.

When he said this, he really meant it.

"Your Majesty," Queen Ma's voice became even lower, "I am not speaking for Cheng Yushi, I am thinking for Your Majesty. Your Majesty killed Hu Weiyong, and no one in the civil and military circles in the court dared to say no. I thought it was strange at that time, Hu Weiyong has been the prime minister for seven years, does he really have no friends? Is there really no one who can speak for him?"

"Later I figured it out. It's not that I didn't do it, it's that I didn't dare."

"The ministers of the Manchu Dynasty, regardless of whether they had anything to do with Hu Weiyong or not, were eager to cut ties with him. Some people even took the initiative to report others in order to show their loyalty. Isn't that what happened when Zhou Deqing reported on Chen Ning?"

Zhu Yuanzhang tapped his hand twice on the table.

"Cheng Hechuan," he finally spoke, his voice no longer so cold, "How is the prince's investigation of Chen Ning's case going?"
